title: 文本模式 vs 二进制模式：字符数与字节数
expected_output:
字符数          = 5
utf-8 字节数    = 9
gbk   字节数    = 7
逐字符 utf-8 字节数 = [3, 3, 1, 1, 1]

对齐切片（按字符边界切）:
  b[0:3]  = e4b8ad -> '中'
  b[3:6]  = e69687 -> '文'

错位切片（字节下标落在多字节字符中间）:
  b[1:4] = b8ade6 -> UnicodeDecodeError: invalid start byte
  b[2:6] = ade69687 -> UnicodeDecodeError: invalid start byte

结论: 文本文件必须整体读写或按「字符数」定位; 按字节偏移切会截断多字节字符
code:
s = "中文abc"
b = s.encode("utf-8")

print("字符数          =", len(s))
print("utf-8 字节数    =", len(b))
print("gbk   字节数    =", len(s.encode("gbk")))
print("逐字符 utf-8 字节数 =", [len(c.encode("utf-8")) for c in s])
print()

print("对齐切片（按字符边界切）:")
print("  b[0:3]  =", b[0:3].hex(), "->", repr(b[0:3].decode("utf-8")))
print("  b[3:6]  =", b[3:6].hex(), "->", repr(b[3:6].decode("utf-8")))
print()

print("错位切片（字节下标落在多字节字符中间）:")
for lo, hi in ((1, 4), (2, 6)):
    try:
        print("  b[%d:%d].decode() = %r" % (lo, hi, b[lo:hi].decode("utf-8")))
    except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
        print("  b[%d:%d] = %s -> UnicodeDecodeError: %s"
              % (lo, hi, b[lo:hi].hex(), e.reason))
print()
print("结论: 文本文件必须整体读写或按「字符数」定位; 按字节偏移切会截断多字节字符")
